title: COPI Editor
description: A web-based research tool for building the Core Ontology for Petroleum Installations (COPI), a BFO 2020 / IOF-Core aligned OWL 2 DL ontology of oil & gas production equipment. It aggregates terms and definitions from industrial standards (ISO 15926-4, POSC Caesar RDL, CFIHOS, DEXPI, ISO 14224, ISA-5.1, among others) and supports a 5-step axiomatization workflow with expert review, OWL generation and quality checks.
